parsed_proposal.diagnosis: The PhoneticEngine.encode method can throw exceptions when Sephardic apostrophe splitting or name-prefix filtering produces empty intermediate collections. Specifically, when splitting on apostrophes in SEPHARDIC mode, if the last part after splitting is empty, or when all words are removed by prefix filtering, downstream operations like join() or iteration fail on empty collections.
parsed_proposal.hypothesis: Adding explicit empty collection checks before processing will prevent exceptions while preserving normal phonetic encoding behavior.
parsed_proposal.reason: The code needs to handle edge cases where word processing results in empty collections, particularly in SEPHARDIC mode where apostrophe splitting can leave empty strings, and in all modes where prefix filtering might remove all words.
